newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed mostly firmer, led by gains in shorter maturities including LIFFE's three-month EuroSwiss, while the long end rose modestly.
Traders said the market was looking to U.S. data later this week to set the tone.
U.S. data include second quarter preliminary GDP on Thursday and July employment data on Friday.

The Swiss government will release its consumer price index for July tomorrow. The CPI for Zurich, Switzerland's largest city, was reported on Friday down 0.1 percent from June. Zurich year-on-year inflation was unchanged at plus 0.4 percent.
Conf futures up four basis points at 120.30.
Euro Swiss francs up five at 98.40.
